items.statement: Higher-triplet couplings exceed the T1 coupling in a complete outcome.
items.expected: For status complete, both S1/T6 and S1/T7 SOCs exceed S1/T1 SOC; this conclusion is not applied to status limited.

items.statement: Outcome-appropriate conclusion on the disclosed hRISC hypothesis.
items.expected: For status complete, the large S1-T1 gap and stronger higher-triplet SOCs support higher-triplet hRISC feasibility and disfavor ordinary T1-to-S1 thermal RISC, without claiming a rate or unique mechanism. For status limited, the conclusion states that the hypothesis cannot be assessed because of the reported failed validation and missing observables.
